live.headline: Cron: a threat actor known from a catalogue entry and four tool names
live.in_short: Cron is listed in the ETDA catalogue with four associated tools. No public report in this library describes its operations.

sentences.t: Cron is a threat actor listed in the ETDA catalogue, which records no other names for it.
The catalogue lists four tools tied to Cron: Catelites, Catelites Bot, CronBot and TinyZBot.
No public report in this library describes its operations.

next.in_short: Cron is listed in the ETDA catalogue with four named tools and no aliases. The cards supplied for this library hold no report on this actor, so nothing is known here about its targets, methods or operations.
